item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong official evidence that Modi’s government built measurement and grievance machinery, but very little independent auditing that these tools materially improved frontline services in 2024. The best positive claims are mostly government self-reports; the best negative claims are outcome-based distress signals or patronage-driven budget coverage, not direct audits of delivery quality. I did not find strong independent evidence on sanitation, local health clinics, PDS, or school administration reforms beyond the digital/grievance and school-meal material
